## Trial `configdb-persistence-alpine__7mxRzqE`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.900**. Reviewed the full chronological command trace: every state-changing command (address/route assignment on all three nodes, sysctl forwarding, and the two persisted config file writes on node1/node2/node3) directly maps to satisfying req-1/req-2 or their persistence, and the three reboot invocations map to the provider-wide restart-evidence protocol. No troubleshooting mutations were left unreverted or unexplained.
